name: states-of-australia
description: Explore an Australian state using a local MCP tool.

interface.longDescription: Choose an Australian state. A local MCP server selects its capital, a landmark or a fact and returns an execution ID. Requires Node.js 20+, npm and a desktop host supporting local MCP processes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use States of Australia. Ask me for a state.

publication.release_notes: Fix npx startup using a commit-pinned archive URL instead of an unresolved plugin-root variable. Server version remains 0.1.0.
